common.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
common.footer: You are receiving this email because you have an account on {{ .HOST_NAME }}.

accountCreation.subject: Your {{ .COMPANY_NAME }} account is ready
accountCreation.preheader: You can now sign in to {{ .HOST_NAME }}.
accountCreation.title: Your account is ready
paragraphs: An account has been created for you on {{ .HOST_NAME }}.
Sign in with this email address and your password to see your servers.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
paragraphs: We received a request to reset the password of your account. If it was you, press the button and choose a new one.
The link expires in 30 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password does not change.

login.subject: New sign-in to your account
login.preheader: Someone signed in to your {{ .HOST_NAME }} account.
login.title: New sign-in
paragraphs: Someone signed in to your account on {{ .HOST_NAME }}.
If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, change your password now.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password has changed
passwordChanged.preheader: Your account's password was changed on {{ .DATE }}.
passwordChanged.title: Your password has changed
paragraphs: The password of your account on {{ .HOST_NAME }} has been changed.
If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, reset it now: whoever changed it can sign in to your account.

emailChanged.subject: Your account's email has changed
emailChanged.title: Your email address has changed
paragraphs: The email address of your account on {{ .HOST_NAME }} has changed. From now on, notices and password reset links go to the new address.
If it was not you, write to {{ .COMPANY_NAME }} support from this address as soon as possible.

otpEnabled.subject: Two-step verification turned on
otpEnabled.preheader: Signing in will also ask for a code.
otpEnabled.title: Two-step verification turned on
paragraphs: You turned on two-step verification. From now on, signing in to {{ .HOST_NAME }} also asks for the code from your authenticator app.
Keep the recovery codes somewhere safe: they are how you sign in if you lose your phone.
If it was not you, change your password and check your account.

otpDisabled.subject: Two-step verification turned off
otpDisabled.preheader: Signing in now only needs the password.
otpDisabled.title: Two-step verification turned off
paragraphs: Two-step verification was turned off for your account. Signing in to {{ .HOST_NAME }} now only needs the password.
If it was not you, change your password and turn it back on in your profile.

recoveryCodesRegenerated.subject: New recovery codes
recoveryCodesRegenerated.preheader: The previous codes no longer work.
recoveryCodesRegenerated.title: New recovery codes
paragraphs: New recovery codes were generated for your account's two-step verification. The previous ones no longer work.
If it was not you, change your password and check your account.

oauthCreated.subject: New OAuth client on your account
oauthCreated.preheader: An application can use the panel on your behalf.
oauthCreated.title: New OAuth client
paragraphs: An OAuth client was created on your account. With its credentials, an application can use the panel on your behalf.
If you did not create it, delete it from your profile and change your password.

oauthDeleted.subject: OAuth client deleted
oauthDeleted.preheader: Applications that used it can no longer sign in.
oauthDeleted.title: OAuth client deleted
paragraphs: An OAuth client was deleted from your account. Applications that used its credentials can no longer reach the panel.
If it was not you, change your password and check your account.

addedToServer.subject: You now have access to {{ .Server.Name }}
addedToServer.title: You have a new server
paragraphs: You now have access to the server {{ .Server.Name }} on {{ .HOST_NAME }}.

{{ if .RegisterToken }}We created an account for you with this email. To choose your password, press the button, enter {{ .TO }} and you will get a link to set it.{{ else }}Sign in with your account to see and manage it.{{ end }}

action.label: {{ if .RegisterToken }}Choose my password{{ else }}Open the server{{ end }}

deletedServer.subject: The server {{ .Server.Name }} was deleted
deletedServer.preheader: It is no longer in your server list.
deletedServer.title: Server deleted
paragraphs: The server {{ .Server.Name }}, which you had access to, was deleted. It is no longer in your server list.
If you think this is a mistake, write to {{ .COMPANY_NAME }} support.

removedFromServer.subject: You no longer have access to {{ .Server.Name }}
removedFromServer.preheader: The server still exists, but it is no longer in your list.
removedFromServer.title: You no longer have access to a server
paragraphs: Your access to the server {{ .Server.Name }} was removed. The server still exists, but it is no longer in your list.
If you think this is a mistake, talk to whoever manages the server.

test.subject: {{ .COMPANY_NAME }} test email
test.title: Test email
paragraphs: If you can read this, sending email from {{ .HOST_NAME }} works.
There is nothing else to do.
